Q9015.reason: Which metabolic reactions a cell can run is set by the enzymes it produces, and those proteins are specified by its genetic material.

Q9017.reason: In a lien-theory state the majority rule treats a mortgage as a lien only, so it does not sever the joint tenancy and the lien ends when the mortgagor dies.

Q9018.reason: Two years of actual continued at-will employment after the covenant was signed is substantial and supplies the new consideration the modification required.
